1.8–30 MHz 共模扼流圈的首选，尤其 160/80m；也适合宽频段抑制。: The first choice for common-mode chokes on 1.8–30 MHz, especially 160/80 m; also suitable for broadband suppression.
GB/T 9254.1（对应 CISPR 32；旧版 GB 9254 对应 CI: GB/T 9254.1 (corresponds to CISPR 32; the older GB 9254 corresponds to CISPR 22)
VHF/UHF 干扰电视时，优先检查接头与分配器的屏蔽是否完好。: When VHF/UHF interferes with television, first check whether the shielding of connectors and splitters is intact.
VHF/UHF 抑制与高频扼流；用在 HF 上几乎没有效果。: VHF/UHF suppression and RF choking; almost ineffective when used on HF.
《中华人民共和国无线电管理条例》: Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Radio Administration
业余业务不得对其他业务产生有害干扰；业余电台对 ISM（工科医）设备的干扰无保护: The amateur service must not cause harmful interference to other services; amateur stations have no right to protection from interference by ISM equipment and can only avoid it themselves.
中短波到 6m 常用；在 160/80m 的阻抗低于 31 型。: Commonly used from medium wave to 6 m; its impedance on 160/80 m is lower than type 31.
信息技术设备的无线电骚扰限值与测量方法，对应 FCC Part 15 的 IT: Limits and methods of measurement of radio disturbance for information technology equipment, corresponding to the IT equipment part of FCC Part 15.
偏重低频抑制，用于电力线噪声等场景。: Biased towards low-frequency suppression, used for power-line noise and similar cases.
先判断干扰是出站（自己干扰别人）还是入站（别人干扰自己）。: First decide whether the interference is outbound (you interfering with others) or inbound (others interfering with you).
先礼后兵：出现干扰先自查，再与邻居沟通，必要时请无线电管理机构协助。: Courtesy first: when interference appears, check your own station first, then talk to the neighbours, and ask the radio regulatory body for help if necessary.
发射功率、天线高度与干扰成正比，必要时降低功率或调整天线方向。: Interference grows with transmit power and antenna height; reduce power or re-aim the antenna if necessary.
发射机谐波与寄生发射须抑制到规定限值以下（相对载波的 dBc 与绝对功率双重约束: Transmitter harmonics and parasitic emissions must be suppressed below the prescribed limits (dual constraints: dBc relative to the carrier and absolute power); adding a low-pass filter is the most direct measure.
发射端加低通滤波器，抑制谐波对电视、电话的干扰。: Fit a low-pass filter at the transmitter to suppress harmonic interference to television and telephones.
向电网与空间辐射宽频噪声，反向干扰中短波接收。: They radiate broadband noise into the mains and into space, in turn interfering with medium-wave and shortwave reception.
在设备电源线与信号线上加磁珠、穿心电容滤除高频。: Fit ferrite beads and feed-through capacitors on power and signal leads to filter out RF.
大功率发射导致画面条纹、啸叫或遥控失灵，最常见于 HF 发射。: High-power transmissions cause picture stripes, howling or remote-control failure, most commonly on HF.
家用电器、电动工具的无线电骚扰限值。: Radio disturbance limits for household appliances and electric tools.
对固定的强干扰（本地广播、邻近中继）用陷波器抑制；整体过载时先加衰减器。: Use a notch filter against fixed strong interferers (local broadcast, a nearby repeater); when there is general overload, add an attenuator first.
对敏感设备加装金属屏蔽罩，减小信号耦合路径。: Add a metal shield to sensitive equipment to reduce signal coupling paths.
屏蔽不良的分配器与接头易引入干扰，需换屏蔽件。: Poorly shielded splitters and connectors readily admit interference; replace them with shielded parts.
开关电源谐波污染接收，劣质充电器尤为明显。: Switching-supply harmonics pollute reception; cheap chargers are especially bad.
强信号区接收变差先怀疑前端过载去敏与互调，而不是「天线不好」——加衰减器或预选器: In strong-signal areas, suspect front-end overload desensitisation and intermodulation rather than a "bad antenna" — verify by adding an attenuator or preselector.
强信号环境下先用带通滤波器或预选器抑制带外能量，避免前端过载去敏。: In strong-signal environments, use a band-pass filter or preselector first to reject out-of-band energy and avoid front-end overload desensitisation.
接收端带通 / 预选器: Band-pass filter / preselector at the receiver
确定干扰方向: Determine the direction of the interference
约 5–50 MHz 及 VHF 低端: About 5–50 MHz and the lower VHF range
绕共模扼流圈前先选材质：1.8–30MHz 用 31 型、5–50MHz 用 4: Choose the material before winding a common-mode choke: type 31 for 1.8–30 MHz, type 43 for 5–50 MHz, type 61 above 200 MHz.
调制解调器受 HF 干扰掉线，需在电话线入口加装滤波器。: The modem drops out under HF interference; fit a filter where the telephone line enters.
降低设备外壳射频电位，减少不必要的辐射与耦合。: Lowers the RF potential of the equipment chassis, reducing unwanted radiation and coupling.
音频线拾取射频信号，整流后从喇叭中听到广播声。: Audio cables pick up RF, which is rectified and heard as broadcast audio from the speakers.
馈线尽量远离电话线、有线电视线与电源线，减小感应耦合。: Keep feedlines away from telephone, cable-TV and power lines to reduce inductive coupling.
馈线绕磁环（巴伦），抑制馈线屏蔽层上的共模电流。: Wind the feedline on a toroid (balun) to suppress common-mode current on the feedline shield.
